I replied to Pree in a thread on her #central-team message: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

I found it in #central-team, which she's in. She posted it there herself on 9 Jun 2026: the morning receiver at Pine Crossing said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written down on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template and ask support to reproduce the problem using the store's login. Nobody has posted in the channel since to say it was fixed, and I told her that.

The channel and the Central files she can see only give the store's name, Pine Crossing. They don't have a separate address or site code for it.
